name: lvx_list_row_trailing

provenance.source: IDA sub_C272C8E; reads row+96 trailing control during layout; sub_C272E1C stores trailing at row+96 (0x60)

notes: band-9 has no standalone 6-instruction trailing getter matching band-10 sub_C4A7F2C (which returns row+0x50). band-9 stores the trailing control at row+0x60 (96) and reads it inline; the closest function that dereferences the trailing field is the layout helper sub_C272C8E. For a bare field read use *(void **)(row + 96).
